statement: Let ℓ be a line of lattice sites parallel to a nearest-neighbor direction. The plane law is reflection positive across ℓ. This remains true after adjoining any finite collection of phase fields Zθ(u) = Uθ exp{iθ(H(u) − H(o))}, θ ∈ R, (5.1) where the Uθ’s are independent uniform points of the unit circle, independent of the pair, and o is any anchor. 23 More precisely, let Θℓ denote spatial reflection, and let Aℓ consist of cylinder functions supported in one closed half-plane, with increments evaluated along paths in that half-plane. Then ⟨F, G⟩ℓ = E [ ΘℓF G ] is positive semidefinite. In its quotient completion, normal translation farther into the half-plane by √ 3 is a positive self-adjoint contraction S. Tangential translation by one lattice unit is a commuting unitary operator. On mesh δ, the normal step is √ 3δ.
